correctness.rationale: The distribution-free kernel is reconstructed via strictly positive tour weights and the explicit two-eigenvalue uniform covariance on the crown-graph cycle space. Orthogonal complementary minors plus total unimodularity/Kirchhoff give equal all-law saturated determinants, and the crown Laplacian yields the count. The actual standalone checker passed 3,244 exact pair moments for n=3..7, fundamental-cycle eigenvector identities, exhaustive n=3,4 full-support and asymmetric-weight n=4 determinant classifications, and 120 n=5 sampled-design checks. These finite checks support, but do not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The natural sampling object is a full Hamiltonian-tour ensemble and all first-degree arc Walsh measurements. At the intrinsic information-theoretic maximal feature count, all coordinate sets preserving information are exactly classified and are universally D-optimal for every strictly positive tour distribution; the common information volume and two exact spectral stability levels are structural quantities useful in constrained harmonic reconstruction. This is not merely recomputation of one graph tree count, and the full-support law robustness goes beyond an incidental finite example.
